temporal_anchor.task_context: Bristlecone Oracle Cloud HCM Full End-to-End Application Submission & Archiving

psychological_state.behavioral_observations: User demanded completion of the submission step once all validations were verified, requiring precise documentation of the submit button architecture, click mechanics, and the persistent organization of company/role-level application output files.

cognitive_evolution.previous_paradigm: Stopping at pre-submission verification without capturing the exact submit button DOM hierarchy and post-submission confirmation flow.
cognitive_evolution.new_paradigm: Full Lifecycle Completion: Inspecting the submit button's Knockout binding (data-bind='... click: submit, enable: isSubmitEnabled()'), triggering the click, awaiting route transition to /my-profile, capturing confirmation metadata ('Status: Under Consideration', Job ID: 11480), taking full-page receipt screenshots, and archiving all assets into profiles/<candidate>/APPLIED ON COMPANY WEBSITE/<Company>/<Job Role>/.
cognitive_evolution.reason_for_shift: Direct user authorization to execute submission, document the submit mechanics, and establish permanent application archives.

long_term_application: For all Oracle Cloud HCM career sites: Submit button is button.apply-flow-pagination__submit-button with Knockout enable: isSubmitEnabled(). When clicked with 0 errors, it navigates to /my-profile showing 'Under Consideration' and 'Applied on MM/DD/YYYY'. Always archive answers.json, resume, cover letter, and submission_confirmation.png in dedicated company/role subdirectories.
